Clinical details: 46M, mountain bike accident, over the handlebars onto head. Helmeted. Right-sided neck pain, no neurological deficit. GCS 15. Trauma team alert.

Technique: Non-contrast CT head and cervical spine with sagittal and coronal reformats.

No intracranial haemorrhage or extra-axial collection. No midline shift. No skull vault or skull base fracture. Grey-white differentiation preserved.

Minimally displaced fracture of the right C6 lateral mass extending into the right foramen transversarium. Undisplaced fracture of the right C6 lamina. No other cervical spine fracture. Alignment maintained. Craniocervical junction intact. Prevertebral soft tissue swelling anterior to C5 to C7. CT angiogram of the neck is recommended to assess the vertebral arteries.

Conclusion:
1. Minimally displaced right C6 lateral mass fracture involving the foramen transversarium, with undisplaced right C6 laminar fracture.
2. No other acute traumatic injury.

Preliminary findings relayed to the trauma team leader in CT at 17:51.
